messages:
dan: FYI audit alarm: several recent backup uploads show SSE-KMS missing. saw 4 PutObject events to redwood-prod-backups without SSE header between 2026-03-23T03:02 and 03:05.
ari: any idea root cause? uploads are normally SSE-KMS by default.
mike: checked KMS grants: looks like an automated grant-prune job removed an explicit kms:Encrypt grant for role `backup-service` on CMK arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/zz11-yy22. janitor-bot ran at 2026-03-23T02:58:00Z and pruned grants lacking recent usage.
janitor-bot: action log: removed 1 grant id=gr-0a1b2c reason="no-usage-evidence" applied_at=2026-03-23T02:58:00Z.
dar: oops. backup-service relied on that grant (usage counted differently); pruning criteria too strict.
oncall-sre: immediate containment: can we block further uploads? set bucket PutObject deny when x-amz-server-side-encryption missing.
mike: applied deny at 2026-03-23T03:10Z. also reinstating the grant now from KMS key policy: `aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:... --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/backup-service --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey`
security-bot: audit: 4 affected objects: [backup-2026-03-23-a1.tar.gz, b2.tar.gz, c3.tar.gz, d4.tar.gz]. proposed remediation: re-encrypt from ingest cache or re-upload from source.
ari: do we have ingest cache for these?
mike: yes within 72h window. starting streaming re-put job to re-upload with --sse aws:kms using the restored grant. will verify checksums.
compliance: please compile tenant list and prepare notification template. mark potential PII until proven otherwise.
dar: long term fixes: 1) change janitor to ignore keys tagged `redwood:backup=true` 2) add KMS grant monitoring + alert when grant removal affects allowed principals 3) add pre-deploy rule preventing removal of kms:Encrypt from known roles 4) default bucket encryption as last defense.
oncall-sre: keeping deny in place until re-uploads verified. created ticket INF-5601 and linked runbook.
mike: re-upload done at 2026-03-23T03:34Z, checksums match originals, SSE metadata present. removing temporary deny at 03:40Z after smoke tests.
dar: will open PR for janitor change and add unit test for grant pruning. thanks all.
